notes: re-scoped from the shared unit to sysml alone (ADR-0015)
decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.17.4. The clause and the Xtext state this production identically — `ownedRelatedElement += TriggerExpression` in both — so there is nothing to weigh. It contributes no tokens, and like SatisfactionFeatureValue and FeatureBinding it carries no '=' or ':=': a trigger is bound to its parameter by position, so the FeatureValue exists in the model with no operator written.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription.
In line 18 `then accept sig after 10[SI::s];` this production holds the whole `after 10[SI::s]`, with nothing written between the parameter and its value.
Second opinion. Identical to the clause.
